work.name: World Bank
work.summary: Working on diverse energy sector projects, spanning analytical work and infrastructure project implementation.

work.name: Rhiza Research
work.summary: Director at Rhiza Research, a non-profit focused on developing open technologies for people and the planet, with a special focus on energy and weather forecasting.

work.name: nLine
work.summary: Developed innovative sensing and data analytics methods to enhance situational awareness, investment targeting, and impact evaluation for electric grids in Sub-Saharan Africa. Collaborated with diverse partners, including academics and utilities, and secured multiple research grants.

work.name: International Energy Agency
work.summary: provided analysis and modeling focused on energy access for the IEA's battery report; worked with industry and academic experts to build models projecting global battery capacity additions..

work.name: PingThings
work.summary: Led PingThings' data science team to develop transmission monitoring tools leveraging novel high resolution sensors, high performance data storage and access systems, and innovative algorithms for large American utilities. I also led execution and delivery of a large Department of Energy research grant on applications of machine learning for power systems event detection.

work.name: TERRA-MEPP
work.summary: Developed image processing algorithms to estimate sorghum biomass from field images collected by a robot, improving efficiency in biofuel development. Participated in field tests at the University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign, and mentored visiting student researchers from Brazil.

work.name: Inscopix
work.summary: Developed a simulator to generate accurate synthetic microscopic images of neuronal activity, incorporating biological, optical, and imaging process factors. Utilized the simulator to evaluate and optimize image processing algorithms.

volunteer.summary: Helped a local senior center consider the costs and benefits of an on-site solar+storage system.

awards.title: Samuel Silver Memorial Scholarship
awards.summary: Presented annually to an Electrical Engineering or Computer Sciences undergraduate or graduate student who best combines intellectual achievement in science and engineering (in the classroom or in research activities) with serious humanistic and cultural interests. Recipients possess outstanding accomplishments in music, art, and other areas of the humanities.

awards.title: Berkeley EECS Excellence Award
awards.summary: Supplementary graduate fellowship based on outstanding academic performance.
